resources.string: Looking for Android TV and Google TV devices on your Wi-Fi…
Nothing found? The phone and the TV box must be on the same Wi-Fi (not a guest network), and the TV box must be switched on. You can also enter its IP address.
For example 192.168.1.50. On the TV box: Settings → Network → your Wi-Fi network.
%1$s does not answer. Is it switched on and on the same Wi-Fi?
%1$s no longer knows this phone. Pair it again.
Another device answers at the address of %1$s. If you reset or replaced the TV box, pair it again.
The TV\'s address is not on this phone\'s network. If both are on the same Wi-Fi, switch off the VPN on the phone and enter the TV\'s IP address by hand.
The TV screen shows a code of 6 characters (digits and letters A–F). Type it here:
The phone could not open a connection to the TV box (reason below). Tap "Check connection" to see which part does not answer.
This code does not match. Check the letters and digits on the TV screen.
The TV box did not accept the code. Start again: a new code will appear.
First open a search or text field on the TV.
This is not a package name or a link.
Power puts the TV box to sleep. It can be woken only while it stays connected to Wi-Fi.
A VPN can hide the TV: switch it off while you use the remote.
Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as the TV (not the guest network).

Shows the TV box\'s screen on the phone. It needs network debugging on the TV, the same as «Speed up TV»: TV Settings → Device preferences → About → press «Build» 7 times, then Developer options → Network debugging (or USB debugging) on.
Look at the TV: allow debugging from this phone (tick «Always allow»).
No picture. Is network debugging on and this phone allowed on the TV?
A text field is open on the TV. Every letter you type here appears there at once.
Make sure the TV box is on and connected to the same Wi-Fi as this phone.
Log copied. Paste it into the support chat.
Nothing answers at this address. Is the TV box on and awake? Some routers keep devices apart (guest network or "client isolation"): use the main Wi-Fi.
The TV box answers, but its remote service is off. On the TV box: Settings → Apps → Android TV Remote Service: enable or update it.
The ports are open, but the secure connection failed. Tap "Copy log" and send it to us.
The connection works. Tap "Try again" or start pairing again.
Only part of the TV box answers. Restart the TV box and try again; if it repeats, send the log.
The TV box answered, but the secure connection failed. Tap "Copy log" and send it to us.
The TV box refused the pairing request. Start again; if it repeats, send the log.
Swipe for arrows, tap for OK
A light buzz of the phone on every press.
Volume, channels and arrows repeat while held, like a real remote.
How do you like to steer?
Say what to search for on the TV
This phone has no voice input.
Open an app on the TV box
Looking for the TV box on your Wi-Fi…

No TV box with debugging switched on was found on this Wi-Fi. On the TV box: Settings → Device Preferences → Developer options → USB debugging (or Network debugging) on. Phone and TV box on the same Wi-Fi.
The TV box did not allow this phone. Look at the TV: tick «Always allow from this computer» and press OK, then tap Connect again.
The TV box was found but did not open debugging. Restart the TV box and tap Connect again.
